text: 1. Hold a foreign ordinary passport; have a high school diploma or above, and be in good health. 2. At least 16 years old; for those who are under 18 years old as of August 31 of the application year, a guarantee letter from a Chinese or foreign adult guardian residing in China must be provided (the guardian guarantee letter template can be downloaded from the download center page). 3. In accordance with the regulations stipulated in the document "Jiaowai Hanfeng [2020] No. (For one year, if the actual residence abroad is 9 months or more, it can be calculated as one year, based on the entry and exit stamps.) 4. Language proficiency requirements: For applications requiring Chinese language instruction, one must have a HSK level 4 or above (190 points or above for science and engineering majors, 210 points or above for liberal arts and business majors, with a writing score of 60 points or above). If a proof of previous Chinese language instruction during the academic stage can be provided, the HSK certificate is not required. Applicants for English-taught programs should have a TOEFL score of 80 (inclusive) or above, an IELTS score of 6.0 (inclusive) or above, or a Duolingo score of 105 (inclusive). If applicants can provide proof of English-taught study during their previous academic stage or if they are native English speakers, they may be exempted from submitting English language proficiency test scores.
